api_bind_address.description: IP address on which the API/control interface listens.

api_bind_port.description: Port for the API/control interface (must be between 1 and 65535).

zone_dir.description: Directory where the distributor stores transferred zone files (must exist and be writable by the service).

journal_dir.description: Directory where journal files for incremental transfers are stored.

max_concurrent_transfers.description: Maximum number of concurrent AXFR/IXFR transfers per peer.

transfer_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for individual AXFR/IXFR transfers.

validate_dnssec.description: Enable DNSSEC validation of transferred zones before distribution.

zones.description: List of DNS zones to distribute. Each entry defines a zone name, its authoritative source server, and optional access/transfer settings.

name.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of the zone to distribute (e.g., example.com).

source.description: IP address or hostname and optional port of the primary DNS server (e.g., 192.0.2.1 or 192.0.2.1:53).

allowed_peers.description: List of IP addresses or CIDR subnets allowed to request transfers. If empty, all peers may request.

prefer_ixfr.description: If true, prefer IXFR if the source supports it; otherwise, fall back to AXFR.

log_file.description: Path to a log file. If empty, logs go to stdout.

zone_cache_size.description: Maximum size (in MiB) of zone data cached in memory (0 means unlimited).

check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between zone change checks (IXFR queries) for active zones.

stats_bind_address.description: IP address for the stats endpoint (only used if stats are enabled).

stats_bind_port.description: Port for the stats endpoint (only used if stats are enabled).
